title: Linus Embraces the Bot, and the Baltics Shut the Pipe
description: Linus Torvalds submits his first AI-assisted patch to the Linux kernel as disclosure rules shift. Meanwhile, Estonia seeks a permanent shutdown of Baltic gas transit infrastructure connected to Kaliningrad.

stories.title: Linus Torvalds posts his first AI-assisted patch to the Linux kernel, synthetic test clocks 23x performance leap
stories.summary: Linus Torvalds published his first AI-assisted code patch to address CPU cache contention in the Linux kernel while maintainers prepare to remove AI disclosure requirements.
stories.label: Torvalds’ first AI-assisted patch

stories.title: Estonia wants to block Russian gas transit through Baltics for good
stories.summary: Estonia's energy minister announced plans to negotiate with Latvia to permanently halt natural gas transit infrastructure linked to Russia's Kaliningrad exclave.
stories.label: Estonia moves to block Russian gas

stories.title: Zelensky rallies EU support as Trump says Ukraine leader 'more difficult to deal with than Putin'
stories.summary: The US president launches a new wave of blistering criticism at Volodymyr Zelensky ahead of a meeting of EU leaders in Brussels.
stories.label: Zelensky rallies EU support

stories.title: Germany, France agree on deal to support Europe's struggling car industry
stories.summary: The two countries said the agreement aimed to safeguard Europe's automotive industry, encouraging development and research. Automakers in Europe have so far struggled to compete with Chinese electric
stories.label: Berlin and Paris back carmakers

stories.title: Trump just effectively killed a popular solar energy program for rural America
stories.summary: Solar panels can be an economic lifeline for farmers. Now they're going to be a lot harder to build.
stories.label: Rural solar programme cut

stories.title: Jailbroken PS5s can now run local AI models at over 100+ tokens per second
stories.summary: Developers released a native fork of PS5LM enabling jailbroken PlayStation 5 consoles to execute large language models locally using the system's GPU and memory.
stories.label: Local AI on jailbroken PS5s

stories.title: How to be a (Roman) man
stories.summary: An essay by Catharine Edwards in Aeon examines Cicero's philosophy of civic virtue and self-control during the crisis of the late Roman Republic.
stories.label: How to be a Roman man

stories.title: After almost three years of early access, Enshrouded has hit 1.0 with a complete story, bigger map, and way too much more to mention
stories.summary: Survival crafting game Enshrouded has exited early access after nearly three years to release its complete 1.0 version.
stories.label: Enshrouded reaches 1.0

stories.title: Sega and Creative Assembly remove Total War: Shogun 2 remaster from sale as it "falls short of both your expectations and our own standards"
stories.summary: Sega and Creative Assembly pulled the Total War: Shogun 2 remaster from sale following community complaints regarding AI upscaling artifacts and performance flaws.
stories.label: Shogun 2 remaster pulled

stories.title: Here are the key things Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh said — and didn’t say — while Americans were sleeping Thursday night
stories.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh delivered a speech without signaling future interest rate moves ahead of the central bank's upcoming policy meeting.
stories.label: Fed chair Warsh’s speech

stories.title: PhD students who write dissertation with AI less likely to stay in academia
stories.summary: A Nature report found that PhD candidates who write their dissertations using generative AI are less likely to pursue careers in academia.
stories.label: AI-written PhDs and academia

stories.title: KDE turns 30 with Plasma 6.8, remote upgrades, and an X11 farewell
stories.summary: The KDE project celebrated its 30th anniversary by releasing Plasma 6.8 and phasing out support for the X11 windowing system.
stories.label: KDE turns 30

predictions.text: The cache contention patch will formally merge into the mainline Linux kernel tree before the end of the year.
